name: bionic-emphasis-text
title: Bionic Emphasis Text
description: Reading-aid typography that bolds the leading fragment of every word at a set attention ratio, guiding the eye through long paragraphs without changing a single word — a genuine legibility system, not decoration.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Humanist
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
